title: Bruno Remembers Everything
moral: Planning ahead helps you stay organized and prepared.

scenes.summary: Bruno the dog enjoys going out but often forgets his things.
scenes.text:
Bruno the Dog Who Forgot His Things

In a busy little town, lived a cheerful dog named Bruno.

Bruno loved going out every day.

He went to the park, visited friends, and played games.

But there was one problem…

Bruno always forgot his things.
scenes.image_prompt: happy dog heading out in town without belongings, bright cartoon style

scenes.summary: Bruno repeatedly forgets important items despite reminders.
scenes.text:
“Don’t forget your hat!” said his owner.

“Okay!” Bruno said.

But when he reached the park…

“Oh no! My hat!” he barked.

Another day—

“Take your water bottle,” said his owner.

“Got it!” Bruno said.

But he forgot it too!
scenes.image_prompt: dog realizing he forgot items at park, looking surprised, colorful cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Bruno faces discomfort because he forgot important items on a hot day.
scenes.text:
One sunny day, Bruno went out to play.

The sun was very hot.

“I’m thirsty,” he said.

But he had no water.

“And it’s too bright!” he added.

But no hat either!

Bruno felt uncomfortable.
scenes.image_prompt: dog tired under hot sun without hat or water, bright cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: Coco suggests making a checklist to help Bruno remember things.
scenes.text:
Just then, Coco the Cat came by.

“Why do you look so tired?” she asked.

“I forgot my things again,” Bruno said.

Coco smiled.

“I have an idea,” she said.

“Make a checklist.”

“Before you leave, check everything.”

Bruno nodded.

“That’s smart!”
scenes.image_prompt: cat giving advice to dog about checklist, friendly cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Bruno uses a checklist and enjoys a well-prepared day.
scenes.text:
The next day, Bruno made a list:

Hat ✔️
Water bottle ✔️
Snacks ✔️

He checked each item carefully.

“This time, I won’t forget!” he said.

Bruno went to the park.

He had his hat.

He had his water.

He had everything!

“I feel great!” he said.

Being organized helps you avoid problems.

A little planning makes things easier.

The End
